# FY1981 net interest outlays from Treasury Bulletin Nov 1981, FFO-5 Budget Outlays by Function
# Net interest, FY1981 = 68.7 billion; FY1980 = 52.5 billion (nominal $)
lam = 0.75

v1981 = 68.7
v1980 = 52.5

def boxcox(y, lam):
    return (y**lam - 1) / lam

b1981 = boxcox(v1981, lam)
b1980 = boxcox(v1980, lam)

diff = round(b1981 - b1980, 4)
print(diff)
